articleTitle: Our MCP probe missed the paid default

figures.alt: Identical software messages travel above an empty tray and a hidden compartment collecting tokens. Editorial illustration.
The HISTOR probe selects preview and records zero mock credits. An empty argument object selects the handler purchase default and records seven mock credits.
Two timelines show a seven-credit charge preceding a tool error or client timeout. A separate retry strip shows one charge for two calls with the same operation key.
